summary: SEC-1 is fixed: answer takes --question-file <path>|-, every SKILL.md/protocol.md call site uses it, the never-interpolated rule is stated, and tests prove metacharacter-safe storage; the fix introduces no new defect, but the inline '<recommended>'/'<answer>' argument from the round-4 fix text remains unaddressed (pre-existing, non-blocking).

findings.summary: ENG-25: the answer value is still interpolated inside shell single quotes ('<recommended>' / '<answer>'), although the new never-interpolated rationale (text from agent output over repository content) applies equally to the cruise and fast-mode recommended value.
findings.evidence: protocol.md:110 `factory answer <qid> '<recommended>' --question-file <temp-file> --auto` and `... --cruise-override`; protocol.md:112 `'<answer>'`; SKILL.md:37, 53, 78, 86 and 146 use the same form. `recommended` is a field of the agent-produced question JSON, which this diff now treats as untrusted. A value such as `the factory's default` breaks the quoting, and `x'; cmd; '` runs a command. The round-4 verdict fix asked for 'the same file form or an explicit shell-escape rule' for this argument; cli.py:418-437 adds only --question-file. The same inline pattern exists on origin/main (cruise path), so this diff does not introduce it or make it worse; it is a gap left open from the prior fix text.
findings.fix: Add an `--answer-file <path>|-` form (or read the answer from the question file's chosen/recommended field when --auto/--cruise-override is set), and change the call sites to use it. Otherwise, state an explicit POSIX single-quote escaping rule (' -> '\'') at protocol.md Relay step 2/4. Add a CLI test with `'` and `$()` in the answer value.
